test_vector_int: test the pybind11 VectorInt STL binder for append, insert, extend, slice assignment, and clear operations
test_vector_buffer: test the pybind11 VectorUChar buffer protocol interface with bytearray and memoryview round-trip access
test_vector_buffer_numpy: test the pybind11 VectorInt numpy array interop including asarray conversion and dtype struct binding
test_noncopyable_containers: test pybind11 noncopyable container binders for vector, deque, map, and unordered_map iteration and access
test_map_delitem: test the pybind11 MapStringDouble and UnorderedMapStringDouble binders for item assignment and deletion
